pooling: the graph's own `sentence_embedding` output, taken as-is: the exporter's pooling head over `last_hidden_state`, which the session verifies at load is unit-norm as emitted and is not the masked mean of `last_hidden_state`; the input framed as the shipped tokenizer.json post-processor frames it, <bos> text <eos>
prefix_note: EmbeddingGemma's documented document prompt (title: none | text: ) and retrieval-query prompt (task: search result | query: ), byte for byte
regime: register rows are the documents, senses are the queries; the prefix is applied to the model input only and the cache text is bare
environment: requirements-ort-frozen.txt (throwaway uv venv; onnxruntime, tokenizers, numpy, huggingface_hub; no torch)
